Why should Dmitri break in on him if she doesn’t come? Speak, I want to know what you are thinking!”

paragraphs.source_en: “He is in very great need of money now—the greatest need, Ivan Fyodorovitch. You don’t know in what need he is,” Smerdyakov explained, with perfect composure and remarkable distinctness. “He looks on that three thousand as his own, too.
